description:
Promoted from deferral #512 of uat-single-connection-registry.
Deferred: Derive credential/secondary-port literals (password=, http_port=, be_http_port=) from canonical sources
Reason deferred: Scoped out by decision (2026-05-31): host reachability + adapter port= now derive from compose; credential and secondary-port literals were relocated into the single docker_assets registry but not yet derived. Env keys vary per platform (ROOT_PASSWORD/POSTGRES_PASSWORD/...) and wrong derivation risks the must_preserve 'no new skips'. Tackle in a dedicated pass.

verifications.expected: all pass, including Compose mutation controls

work_units.evidence: Secondary adapter options now map only role->container port; resolve_published_host_port_for_container derives QuestDB/StarRocks/Doris host values from Compose mappings and honors host env overrides.
work_units.summary: Derive secondary HTTP host ports from Compose container-port roles

work_units.evidence: Managed passwords now map only platform->Compose env key; UAT argv derives ClickHouse, PostgreSQL-family, and SingleStore values from service environments, including default overrides.
work_units.summary: Derive managed Docker passwords from per-platform Compose environment keys

work_units.evidence: 95 focused + 145 Docker/matrix tests pass; mutation controls change Doris secondary ports and SingleStore password only in temporary Compose sources and observe matching argv; static registries contain no derived literals.
work_units.summary: Add mutation controls proving Compose changes flow into UAT argv without new skips
